The authenticated PRE-CU Center of Being uses the separate centerOfBeing command, centerofbeing buff, and brawler efficacy/duration skill modifiers; it does not use either NGE Force Sensitive stance parent.
Later buff, effect-mapping, quest, and zone data can remain loadable for NPC and expansion compatibility without granting player progression authority.
